COLUMBUS, Ohio Oct. 28, 2026 – Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE: VRT) ("Vertiv"), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Vertiv reported third quarter net sales of $4,313 million, an increase of $1,637 million, or 61%, compared to third quarter 2025, reflecting 55% organic sales growth and approximately 6% contribution from acquisitions. Growth was broad-based across all regions, with the Americas up 75% (66% organic), APAC up 50% (48% organic), and EMEA up 23% (19% organic). Strong demand visibility, ongoing capacity investments, and disciplined execution give Vertiv the confidence to raise full year net sales guidance by $650 million, along with increases to other associated financial metrics. Third quarter operating profit of $984 million increased $467 million and adjusted operating profit of $1,087 million increased $491 million, up 90% and 83%, respectively, from third quarter 2025. Adjusted operating margin was 25.2%, up 290 basis points compared to third quarter 2025, driven by operational leverage on higher sales and by manufacturing productivity, partially offset by mix impacts and continued growth investments. "We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating," said Giordano Albertazzi, Vertiv's Chief Executive Officer. "The demands on data center infrastructure are evolving faster than ever, and Vertiv's
e very hard to replicate. We are expanding capacity, improving productivity, and executing with rigor. The infrastructure we deliver performs at the highest levels of reliability. Customers are choosing Vertiv as the partner that can engineer, deliver, scale and service across the entire lifecycle. Our more than 100% organic orders growth year over year and our overall performance are clear testaments to that." "The companies that will define the digital age are the ones investing ahead of the curve and delivering for customers, and that is what we are doing," said Dave Cote, Vertiv's Executive Chairman. "We are in an industry where the more technology changes, the better it is for us. We keep investing, we keep building, and what we have built is designed to scale. I believe there is a long runway ahead and the opportunity only gets bigger from here." Adjusted Free Cash Flow and Liquidity Net cash generated by operating activities in the third quarter was $794 million, and adjusted free cash flow was $652 million, increasing 64% and 50%, respectively, from third quarter 2025. Third quarter adjusted free cash flow was driven by higher adjusted operating profit partially offset by increased working capital and higher capital expenditures to support growth. dance The data center market continues to generate strong, broad-based global demand, further validating the depth and duration of the growth cycle. Vertiv continues to expand capacity and invest in next-generation technology to stay ahead of customer needs and capture an expanding opportunity set.
